info.description: The Factorio Expo API. The operations in the docs (search, entries and their blueprints, raw exchange strings, preview images, tags and mods) are the read API tools may rely on; the rest (marked x-internal) serve the site and may change without notice. Reads are rate limited per IP (429 with Retry-After); be gentle and cache. Entries that are private, deleted or expired answer 404. Errors are application/problem+json with a stable `code`.
